items.title: Stocks trade higher, lifted by crypto, commodities: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Stocks traded in the green at the open on Friday but were still pacing for weekly losses.

items.title: Moderna, Robinhood, Marvell, Tesla, SpaceX, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Moderna shares rise to close out a week of wild swings. Crypto stocks also extend their recent rally.

items.title: Webull Is Having a Monster Quarter. Is BULL Stock Still a Buy?
items.summary: Webull just posted its strongest quarter ever as a public company, fueled by a regulatory change that permanently rewired how millions of traders operate. The real question is whether the stock already drank all the good news before you got there.

items.title: Coinbase Stock Surged On A Bill Its Own CEO Says It Can Live Without
items.summary: Robinhood and Bakkt fell in the very session Coinbase surged, which points the cause at Washington rather than at the price of bitcoin.

items.title: Robinhood Leads Friday’s S&P 500 Gains
items.summary: Robinhood is currently the best performer in the S&P 500 index, up 13%. Shares of the fintech company are on pace for their largest percent increase since February, when they rose 13.95% The company will hit its highest close since July 15 if its current share price near $108 holds.

items.title: Bitcoin Heads for Best Week Since 2024 Amid Trump-Fueled Crypto Rally
items.summary: It’s a stellar week for cryptos—and it’s about more than just President Donald Trump calling for Congress to pass the Clarity Act.

items.title: One Wall Street Analyst Thinks SoFi Stock Could Jump 20%. Here’s Why.
items.summary: SoFi has been punished hard in 2026, but a fresh Wall Street initiation and back-to-back earnings beats are rewriting the story. Whether the bull case or the rate-hike risk wins out depends on factors that make this call genuinely close.

items.title: SoFi Climbs 5% as Robinhood Spikes 13%, Affirm Ticks Up: Is There a Crypto Connection Here?
items.summary: Bitcoin's breakout sent fintech stocks flying Friday, but the gains spread unevenly across SoFi, Robinhood, and Affirm in a way that reveals exactly which names actually have skin in the crypto game.
